valuation_method: All snapshot ledger legs marked at the same prior completed Coinbase minute close preceding closing block. ETH/WETH parity explicit.

limits: Only observed M1 flow edges are reconciled against fresh historical snapshots; residuals expose missing flows/wrapper effects rather than forced balancing.
Token blacklisting is an observed contract state, not proof of seizure or recovery by Binance.
Stablecoin balance destruction/redemption can change balances without ordinary transfer events.
Snapshot scope omits other tokens, other chains, recipients and post-window transfers.
Frozen balance is part of closing balance, never an additional loss.
